title: DocsMap
description: Story 30.2 (spec-pyforge-doctor CAP-84): docs/map.yaml's own schema -- the machine registry docs/MAP.md's generated Page registry section renders from. One entry per page under the four Diataxis quadrant directories docs/MAP.md governs. sources/stamp/generator are for kind: generated pages (Story 30.3); an authored page's staleness signal comes from that page's OWN frontmatter sources:/verified:, never duplicated here. Story 48.1 (CAP-90): optional sections list orders non-docs site mounts (herald, pipelines, …).

sections.description: Site sections outside the docs shelf (Story 48.1 / CAP-90): ordering and ownership for Pages mounts herald reads in Story 43.7.

sources.description: kind: generated only (Story 30.3) -- the inputs a generator derives the page from.

generator.description: kind: generated only (Story 30.3) -- repo-relative path to the script that derives this page (e.g. scripts/docs_pixi_tasks.py). docs-currency's generated-page-stale check runs it with --check and reads its exit code; the matching pixi task under guild-tasks regenerates it for real.

stamp.description: kind: generated only (Story 30.3) -- derived_at/tree from the generator's last write (herald facts.yaml shape: tree is the HEAD sha, suffixed -dirty when uncommitted; derived_at is the HEAD commit date, not wall-clock time, so a re-run on an unchanged tree writes identical bytes).

label.description: Human menu label for this section.

href.description: Site-root-relative directory path (trailing slash); never absolute or parent-relative.

owner.description: Station slug that publishes this section.

order.description: Sort key among sections; lower appears earlier in nav.

key.description: Stable slug for this entry within its section.
